name: Voyager 1
lastSignal: Still communicating; selected instruments remain active (2026)
tagline: Launched in 1977, Voyager 1 is still whispering across the immense distance between the stars.
credit: Original editorial illustration created for the Left Behind archive.

beats.goal: Fly past Jupiter and Saturn, then continue outward to study the environment beyond the heliosphere.
beats.achieved: Voyager 1 discovered active volcanism on Io, studied Saturn and Titan, and crossed the heliopause into interstellar space in 2012. It carries a Golden Record containing sounds and images from Earth.
beats.ending: It has not ended. Its radioisotope power supply gradually weakens, so engineers have been switching off instruments and systems to preserve the remaining science capability.
beats.now: NASA reported in 2026 that Voyager 1 was still operating, with some science instruments active. Its signal takes many hours to reach Earth; its exact distance changes continuously.
beats.learned: The mission transformed planetary science and gave humanity its first direct measurements of the space between the stars.
